title: Complete an independent recovery assessment
goal: Select, recover and justify the right private version.
challenge: Recover alpha for ll-b8, mode600, expected timestamp2026-01-01UTC, into a new empty directory. Keep the current alpha-v2 source, both version archives and independent references. Prove actual ll-b8 read access, wrong-identity denial, exact contents and metadata. Retain a short recovery handover; completion is self-reviewed.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-backup-8; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && saved_umask=$(umask) && umask 077 && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Guard a fresh, learner-owned workspace and check guest free space. Stop if any command fails. Use a private practice-shell umask; restore the saved value during cleanup.
steps.expected: Private practice directory; at least 65536 KiB available.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-backup-8 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-backup-8 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && test -z "$(find . -type l -print -quit)"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define and use a location/owner guard for every later change.
steps.expected: Exact physical path, not a link.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0700 source && printf 'alpha\n' > source/note.txt && printf 'bravo\n' > 'source/space name.txt' && chmod 0640 source/note.txt && chmod 0600 'source/space name.txt' && touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Create two known regular files, including a name with a space.
steps.expected: alpha and bravo lines, modes640/600, fixed UTC timestamp.

steps.command: guard && ! getent passwd ll-b8 && ! getent group ll-b8 && sudo useradd -M -U -s /usr/sbin/nologin ll-b8 && sudo passwd -S ll-b8

guard && test ! -e v1.tar && test ! -L v1.tar && test ! -e v2.tar && test ! -L v2.tar && test ! -e versions.sha256 && test ! -L versions.sha256 && chmod 0711 . && chmod 0600 source/note.txt && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf v1.tar -C source -- note.txt && printf 'alpha-v2\n' > source/note.txt && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf v2.tar -C source -- note.txt && sha256sum -- v1.tar v2.tar > versions.sha256
steps.explanation: Create starting backups. Desired recovered ownership is explicitly ll-b8; archived owner is learner. Refuse existing backup/reference names before changing source or writing an archive.
steps.expected: Current v2, previous v1, references retained.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0711 restore && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -xf v1.tar -C restore --no-same-owner --same-permissions && sudo chown ll-b8:ll-b8 restore/note.txt && sudo chmod 0600 restore/note.txt
steps.explanation: Select earlier version and apply declared ownership policy. Never extract over current source.

steps.command:
guard && sudo runuser -u ll-b8 -- cat restore/note.txt && sudo runuser -u ll-b8 -- stat -c '%U:%G %a %Y' restore/note.txt && printf 'alpha
' | sudo cmp - restore/note.txt && printf 'alpha-v2
' | cmp - source/note.txt && sha256sum -c -- versions.sha256; cat restore/note.txt; printf 'wrong identity status=%s
' "$?"
steps.explanation: Gather independent outcomes; a check failure cannot be waved away by self-review.
steps.expected: ll-b8 reads alpha, mode600/expectedmtime, learner denied, live v2/backups unchanged.

steps.command: guard && printf '%s\n' 'POINT: v1; current v2 preserved' 'EVIDENCE: contents, owner/group/mode/mtime, actual user read' 'TRUST: local retained checksum, not signature' 'LIMIT: no ACLs or untrusted archive guarantees' 'CLEANUP: exact practice paths/account only after review' > handover.txt
steps.explanation: Record why the selection meets requirements and its limits.
steps.expected: Concise evidence-based handover, no verification score. Backups/references remain private, not world-readable.

hints: Check access as ll-b8 and denial as learner.
Preserve backups and current source, then justify recovery.
review: v1 selection, exactprivatecontent/metadata/useraccess, originalv2+backups retained and handover.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 206.2 partial manual archives/recovery; 104.5 reinforcement where applicable. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
